name: AI Applyd job search skills
tagline: Fourteen ready-made job search workflows: find matches, tailor, apply, review, track, follow up and prepare
description: Fourteen skills that drive the AI Applyd MCP server: map a request to the right tools, set up a job search, find matching jobs, tailor a resume for a job, write a cover letter, apply to a job, review and send held applications, track applications, prepare for an interview, translate a resume, build an editable resume document, handle recruiter replies, follow up on applications and manage saved searches.
